description:
Blog articles and blog categories. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_articles: List blog articles (metadata only, without HTML content).
- get_article: Get article details by ID (includes the full HTML content)
- create_article: Create a blog article so blog/post pages (post-list, grid-blog, post-overlay) have content.
- update_article: Update a blog article.
- delete_article: Delete blog articles (soft delete — they disappear from the site)
- create_blog_category: Create a blog/article category.
- update_blog_category: Update a blog/article category (name, description, image, slug, SEO).

category_ids.description: Blog category IDs to file the post under (from create_blog_category) [create_article, update_article]

content.description: HTML content of the post [create_article, update_article]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

ids.description: Several article IDs to delete in one call [delete_article]

images.description: Hosted image URLs; the first is the cover image [create_article, update_article]

remove_category_ids.description: Blog category IDs to unfile the post from [update_article]

seo.description: SEO settings to change; other existing SEO tags are kept. [update_article, update_blog_category]

tags.description: Article TAG IDs (uuids from the blog tag list) — not free text [update_article]

term.description: Search articles by title or slug [list_articles]

name: blog
